scripts.dev: start "NEXUS Backend" cmd /k "cd backend && npm run dev" && start "NEXUS Frontend" cmd /k "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.security:audit: npm --prefix backend run security:audit && npm --prefix frontend run security:audit
scripts.security:audit:fix: npm --prefix backend run security:audit:fix && npm --prefix frontend run security:audit:fix
